description_en: Modifies the status of a protection rule
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-defense-rule-status --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --rule-id 20002615 --rule-status 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDefenseRuleStatus

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protection rule template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection rule that you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461426.html operation to query the protection rule ID. You can create a protection rule by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的防护规则ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461426.html接口查询防护规则ID。防护规则可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html接口创建
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The status that you want to set for the protection rule. Valid values: 
0: disabled.  
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的防护规则状态。取值： 
0：关闭  
1：开启
parameters.name: rule_status

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the protection rule
parameters.name: defense_type
